# Potential Data Loss on Compile Failure

Exceptions during the compilation process are caught and logged, but the current transaction is rolled back. Repeated compile failures could lead to incomplete or missing data if not handled correctly.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._compile_one`
